zh.title: 椭圆曲线 → 模形式
zh.mechanism: 把椭圆曲线的算术信息转入模形式与 Galois 表示的语言，利用模性提升连接两侧。
zh.conditions: 本条记录 Wiles 1995 的范围：定义在 Q 上的半稳定椭圆曲线。
zh.conclusion: 这些椭圆曲线具有相应的模参数化；结合 Frey–Ribet 路线可推出费马大定理。
zh.limitations: 此引文不能单独证明所有 Q 上椭圆曲线的完整模性，也不是任意数域的结论。
zh.sourceTitle: Andrew Wiles, Modular elliptic curves and Fermat’s Last Theorem (1995)

en.title: Elliptic curves → Modular forms
en.mechanism: Express the arithmetic information of elliptic curves in the language of modular forms and Galois representations, connecting the two through modularity lifting.
en.conditions: This entry records the scope of Wiles's 1995 result: semistable elliptic curves defined over Q.
en.conclusion: These elliptic curves admit the corresponding modular parametrizations; together with the Frey–Ribet route, this yields Fermat's Last Theorem.
en.limitations: This reference alone does not establish the full modularity theorem for all elliptic curves over Q, and the statement does not concern arbitrary number fields.
en.sourceTitle: Andrew Wiles, Modular elliptic curves and Fermat’s Last Theorem (1995)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 2–3, 7; Theorem 0.4 and its relation to Theorem 0.5
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 模形式 → 八维球堆积
zh.mechanism: 用模形式构造具有所需符号和 Fourier 变换性质的 Schwartz 函数，使 Cohn–Elkies 上界在 E8 上取等。
zh.conditions: 欧氏空间 R^8；同半径球的通常堆积密度。
zh.conclusion: E8 格点堆积达到所有八维球堆积的最大密度。
zh.limitations: 不是仅在格点堆积中最优；也不是任意维数的最优结论。
zh.sourceTitle: Maryna Viazovska, The sphere packing problem in dimension 8 (2017)

en.title: Modular forms → Sphere packing in dimension eight
en.mechanism: Use modular forms to construct a Schwartz function with the required sign and Fourier-transform properties, making the Cohn–Elkies upper bound sharp for E8.
en.conditions: Euclidean space R^8; the usual density of packings by balls of equal radius.
en.conclusion: The E8 lattice packing attains the maximum density among all sphere packings in dimension eight.
en.limitations: Optimality is among all packings, not merely lattice packings. This is not an optimality result in arbitrary dimensions.
en.sourceTitle: Maryna Viazovska, The sphere packing problem in dimension 8 (2017)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 1–3; Theorem 1 and outline of modular-form/Fourier construction
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 霍奇理论结构 → 拟阵对数凹性
zh.mechanism: 给拟阵构造 Chow 环，在其中建立 Hard Lefschetz 与 Hodge–Riemann 关系，再把交叉乘积不等式转为组合系数不等式。
zh.conditions: 有限非空基集上的无自环（loopless）拟阵的 Chow 环；使用其 ample 类。
zh.conclusion: 拟阵特征多项式系数的绝对值构成对数凹序列。
zh.limitations: 不要求拟阵可由向量表示；并非声称每个拟阵都来自一个光滑射影簇。
zh.sourceTitle: Adiprasito, Huh, Katz, Hodge Theory for Combinatorial Geometries (2018)

en.title: Hodge-theoretic structures → Log-concavity for matroids
en.mechanism: Construct a Chow ring for a matroid, establish Hard Lefschetz and Hodge–Riemann relations in that ring, and turn inequalities for intersection products into inequalities for combinatorial coefficients.
en.conditions: The Chow ring of a loopless matroid on a finite, nonempty ground set, together with its ample classes.
en.conclusion: The absolute values of the coefficients of the matroid's characteristic polynomial form a log-concave sequence.
en.limitations: The matroid need not be representable by vectors. This does not assert that every matroid comes from a smooth projective variety.
en.sourceTitle: Adiprasito, Huh, Katz, Hodge Theory for Combinatorial Geometries (2018)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 1–5; loopless definition, characteristic-polynomial conjecture, Chow ring, Theorem 1.4, proof architecture
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 局部引理 → 重抽样算法
zh.mechanism: 对独立随机变量定义坏事件；每遇到坏事件只重抽样其涉及变量，用 witness trees 控制重抽样次数。
zh.conditions: 有限独立变量模型和有限坏事件族；Γ(A) 由共享变量的坏事件构成。 存在 0<x(A)<1，使 P(A)≤x(A)∏_{B∈Γ(A)}(1−x(B))。
zh.conclusion: 得到避开所有坏事件的赋值；事件 A 的期望重抽样次数至多 x(A)/(1−x(A))。
zh.limitations: 运行时间还依赖检测事件和重抽样的成本；不能直接推广到任意依赖模型。
zh.sourceTitle: Moser and Tardos, A constructive proof of the general Lovasz Local Lemma (2009)

en.title: The local lemma → A resampling algorithm
en.mechanism: Define bad events in terms of independent random variables. Whenever a bad event occurs, resample only its variables, using witness trees to bound the number of resamplings.
en.conditions: A finite independent-variable model and a finite family of bad events; Γ(A) consists of bad events sharing variables with A. There are values 0<x(A)<1 such that P(A)≤x(A)∏_{B∈Γ(A)}(1−x(B)).
en.conclusion: The algorithm finds an assignment avoiding every bad event. The expected number of resamplings of event A is at most x(A)/(1−x(A)).
en.limitations: Running time also depends on the costs of detecting events and resampling variables. This does not directly extend to arbitrary dependence models.
en.sourceTitle: Moser and Tardos, A constructive proof of the general Lovasz Local Lemma (2009)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 3; Theorem 1.2, finite variables/events and expected resampling count
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 稠密组合定理 → 素数等差数列
zh.mechanism: 用筛法生成的伪随机控制测度容纳稀疏素数，并建立相对 Szemerédi 定理以迁移稠密集合中的组合结论。
zh.conditions: 每个固定正整数 k。 迁移步骤需要论文中的伪随机性条件，不能仅假定集合无限。
zh.conclusion: 素数中存在任意有限长度的等差数列。
zh.limitations: 不是要求数列由连续素数组成；不能把正整数中的正密度假设直接用于零密度的素数集。
zh.sourceTitle: Green and Tao, The primes contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions (2008)

en.title: A dense combinatorial theorem → Arithmetic progressions of primes
en.mechanism: Place the sparse primes under a pseudorandom majorizing measure built using sieve methods, and prove a relative Szemerédi theorem to transfer combinatorial conclusions from dense sets.
en.conditions: Each fixed positive integer k. The transference step requires the paper's pseudorandomness conditions; infinitude of the set alone is insufficient.
en.conclusion: The primes contain arithmetic progressions of every finite length.
en.limitations: The progression is not required to consist of consecutive primes. A positive-density assumption in the positive integers cannot be applied directly to the zero-density set of primes.
en.sourceTitle: Green and Tao, The primes contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions (2008)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 2–4; Theorems 1.1–1.2 and transference discussion
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 最优输运 → 合成 Ricci 曲率
zh.mechanism: 在概率测度的 Wasserstein 空间上，以熵类泛函沿测地线的位移凸性表达曲率下界。
zh.conditions: 使用 Lott–Villani 论文的紧致测度长度空间与概率测度框架。 有限 N 的非负 N-Ricci 与无限维 K 下界分别有自己的定义。 此版本要求在每对端点之间存在合适的 Wasserstein 测地线，不要求所有测地线都满足。
zh.conclusion: 得到可用于非光滑空间、并在所述 measured Gromov–Hausdorff 极限下保持的曲率条件。
zh.limitations: 不把所有可能的 CD、RCD 或非分支条件混为同一版本。
zh.sourceTitle: Lott and Villani, Ricci curvature for metric-measure spaces via optimal transport (2009)

en.title: Optimal transport → Synthetic Ricci curvature
en.mechanism: Express lower curvature bounds through displacement convexity of entropy functionals along geodesics in the Wasserstein space of probability measures.
en.conditions: The framework of compact measured length spaces and probability measures in the Lott–Villani paper. Nonnegative N-Ricci curvature for finite N and an infinite-dimensional lower bound K have distinct definitions. This version requires the existence of a suitable Wasserstein geodesic between each pair of endpoints; it does not require every such geodesic to satisfy the condition.
en.conclusion: The resulting curvature conditions apply to nonsmooth spaces and are preserved under the measured Gromov–Hausdorff limits specified in the paper.
en.limitations: This entry does not identify all versions of CD, RCD, or nonbranching conditions with one another.
en.sourceTitle: Lott and Villani, Ricci curvature for metric-measure spaces via optimal transport (2009)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 1, 4; Definition 0.7: compact space, existence of a suitable geodesic, weak displacement convexity
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 扩张图 → 纠错码
zh.mechanism: 以具有足够扩张性质的图组织局部校验，使局部错误信号能够引导迭代纠正。
zh.conditions: 图满足构造和解码定理所需的定量扩张条件。 局部码和码率参数必须与选定的 expander-code 构造匹配。
zh.conclusion: 可构造渐近良好码族，并有能纠正常数比例错误的有效解码算法。
zh.limitations: 任意被称为 expander 的图加任意局部码，并不自动满足相同解码保证。
zh.sourceTitle: Sipser and Spielman, Expander Codes (1996)

en.title: Expander graphs → Error-correcting codes
en.mechanism: Organize local checks using graphs with sufficient expansion, so that local error signals can guide iterative correction.
en.conditions: The graph must satisfy the quantitative expansion assumptions of the construction and decoding theorems. The local codes and rate parameters must match the selected expander-code construction.
en.conclusion: One can construct asymptotically good families of codes with efficient decoding algorithms that correct a constant fraction of errors.
en.limitations: An arbitrary graph called an expander, combined with arbitrary local codes, does not automatically provide the same decoding guarantee.
en.sourceTitle: Sipser and Spielman, Expander Codes (1996)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 1 rendered as image; abstract and introduction, construction families and decoding claims
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 模型论稳定性 → 图正则性
zh.endpoints: Stability theory (model theory) → Szemerédi regularity lemma。
zh.mechanism: 将半图序结构识别为模型论不稳定性的组合见证；排除统一大小的半图后应用稳定性理论分解。
zh.conditions: 有限图满足固定 k 的 non-k-order property。 固定近似参数 ε>0。
zh.conclusion: 得到稳定图的加强正则分割，其中没有通常版本中的不规则对，并改善分割规模界。
zh.limitations: 条件不是单纯排除某一种诱导完整图；不能用于所有有限图。
zh.sourceTitle: Malliaris and Shelah, Regularity lemmas for stable graphs (2014)

en.title: Model-theoretic stability → Graph regularity
en.endpoints: Stability theory (model theory) → Szemerédi regularity lemma.
en.mechanism: Recognize half-graph order patterns as combinatorial witnesses of model-theoretic instability. Excluding half-graphs of a uniform size allows a decomposition using stability theory.
en.conditions: Finite graphs with the non-k-order property for a fixed k, and a fixed approximation parameter ε>0.
en.conclusion: Stable graphs admit stronger regularity partitions, with none of the irregular pairs allowed in the usual version and with improved bounds on partition size.
en.limitations: The hypothesis is not merely the exclusion of a particular induced complete graph. The result does not apply to all finite graphs.
en.sourceTitle: Malliaris and Shelah, Regularity lemmas for stable graphs (2014)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 1; abstract and reproduced Theorem 5.18, fixed non-k-order property
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 直觉主义逻辑 ↔ 带类型 λ 演算
zh.mechanism: 把命题对应为类型、证明对应为项、证明归约对应为程序求值；连接引入/消去规则与构造/使用规则。
zh.conditions: 首个基本实例：直觉主义蕴含片段与只有函数类型的简单类型 λ 演算。 扩展到合取、析取、假命题 ⊥ 时，分别加入 product、sum、empty types，并匹配引入和消去规则。
zh.conclusion: 证明对象可作为受类型检查的程序表达，逻辑规则和程序构造建立精确对应。
zh.limitations: 加入任意递归、异常或不受控制的公理后，不能仍无条件把任意程序当作总正确性证明。
zh.sourceTitle: Philip Wadler, Propositions as Types (2015)

en.title: Intuitionistic logic ↔ Typed lambda calculus
en.mechanism: Correspond propositions to types, proofs to terms, and proof reduction to program evaluation; connect introduction and elimination rules with rules for constructing and using terms.
en.conditions: The basic initial example is the implication fragment of intuitionistic logic and the simply typed lambda calculus with function types only. Extending to conjunction, disjunction, and falsity ⊥ requires product, sum, and empty types, respectively, with matching introduction and elimination rules.
en.conclusion: Proof objects can be expressed as type-checked programs, with a precise correspondence between logical rules and program constructions.
en.limitations: After adding unrestricted recursion, exceptions, or uncontrolled axioms, arbitrary programs cannot still be treated unconditionally as proofs of total correctness.
en.sourceTitle: Philip Wadler, Propositions as Types (2015)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 2; intuitionistic natural deduction and simply typed lambda calculus correspondence
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 依赖类型论 ↔ 同伦结构
zh.mechanism: 把类型看作空间、恒等类型看作路径，再把高阶恒等解释为同伦；univalence 将类型相等与等价连接。
zh.conditions: 明确所用依赖类型论、恒等类型规则及 univalence 等额外公理。
zh.conclusion: 可以在该基础内构造和计算同伦不变量，并用同伦语言组织证明。
zh.limitations: 不是说任意传统类型系统已自动满足 univalence，亦不宣称本地图经过证明助手核验。
zh.sourceTitle: The Univalent Foundations Program, Homotopy Type Theory (2013)
zh.locator: Chapter 2: types, identity paths, and univalence。

en.title: Dependent type theory ↔ Homotopy structures
en.mechanism: Interpret types as spaces, identity types as paths, and higher identities as homotopies. Univalence connects equality of types with equivalence.
en.conditions: Specify the dependent type theory, its identity-type rules, and additional axioms such as univalence.
en.conclusion: Within this foundation, one can construct and compute homotopy invariants and organize proofs in the language of homotopy.
en.limitations: This does not mean that every traditional type system automatically satisfies univalence, and it does not claim that this atlas has been checked by a proof assistant.
en.sourceTitle: The Univalent Foundations Program, Homotopy Type Theory (2013)
en.locator: Chapter 2: types, identity paths, and univalence.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 16, 101–102; types/spaces interpretation and Axiom 2.10.3 (univalence); version hott-online-82-g578b85c
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 算子代数 → 纽结不变量
zh.mechanism: 从子因子相关的代数关系得到辫群表示，并用满足 Markov 性质的迹归一化，消除辫表示选择的依赖。
zh.conditions: 温和的有向经典链环；辫闭包和 Markov 等价。 迹与归一化必须满足不变性所需关系。
zh.conclusion: 构造 Jones 多项式这一链环同痕不变量。
zh.limitations: 不变量相同不保证纽结同痕；不能把一个不变量误当完整分类。
zh.sourceTitle: Vaughan Jones, A polynomial invariant for knots via von Neumann algebras (1985)

en.title: Operator algebras → Knot invariants
en.mechanism: Obtain braid-group representations from algebraic relations associated with subfactors, then normalize a trace satisfying the Markov property to remove dependence on the chosen braid representation.
en.conditions: Tame oriented classical links, braid closures, and Markov equivalence. The trace and normalization must satisfy the relations required for invariance.
en.conclusion: This constructs the Jones polynomial as an isotopy invariant of links.
en.limitations: Equal invariants do not guarantee isotopic knots. An invariant is not a complete classification.
en.sourceTitle: Vaughan Jones, A polynomial invariant for knots via von Neumann algebras (1985)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 1–3 through web PDF extraction; braid closure, Markov moves, trace construction, Theorems 1–2
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 覆盖空间 ↔ 基本群的子群
zh.mechanism: 通过路径提升把覆盖的纤维组织为基本群作用；连通覆盖由相应子群刻画。
zh.conditions: 基空间路径连通、局部路径连通、半局部单连通。 带基点版本用子群，忘掉基点的连通覆盖用共轭类。
zh.conclusion: 得到覆盖空间分类与群论对象之间的对应。
zh.limitations: 不能删掉局部条件后仍声称全部经典分类定理成立。
zh.sourceTitle: Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology (2002), Section 1.3

en.title: Covering spaces ↔ Subgroups of the fundamental group
en.mechanism: Path lifting gives an action of the fundamental group on a covering's fiber; connected coverings are characterized by the corresponding subgroups.
en.conditions: The base space is path-connected, locally path-connected, and semilocally simply connected. The based version uses subgroups; connected coverings without chosen basepoints use conjugacy classes of subgroups.
en.conclusion: This gives a correspondence between the classification of covering spaces and group-theoretic objects.
en.limitations: The local hypotheses cannot simply be removed while retaining the full classical classification theorem.
en.sourceTitle: Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology (2002), Section 1.3

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: Chapter 1 PDF pp. 43, 47; semilocal condition and Theorem 1.38
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 根理想 ↔ 仿射代数集合
zh.mechanism: 利用 Hilbert 零点定理把多项式共同零点与消失理想互相转换，I(V(I))=√I。
zh.conditions: k 为代数闭域；k[x1,…,xn] 为有限变量多项式环。
zh.conclusion: 仿射代数集合与根理想之间建立反向包含的双射。
zh.limitations: 一般非代数闭域上只取 k-有理点不能恢复同样的理想；有理点为空不表示理想是单位理想。
zh.sourceTitle: The Stacks Project, Hilbert Nullstellensatz, Tag 00FV
zh.locator: Theorem 10.34.1 and its proof; algebraically closed specialization。

en.title: Radical ideals ↔ Affine algebraic sets
en.mechanism: Hilbert's Nullstellensatz relates common zeros of polynomials to vanishing ideals: I(V(I))=√I.
en.conditions: k is an algebraically closed field, and k[x1,…,xn] is a polynomial ring in finitely many variables.
en.conclusion: Affine algebraic sets and radical ideals are in an inclusion-reversing bijection.
en.limitations: Over a general field that is not algebraically closed, taking only k-rational points does not recover the same ideal. The absence of rational points does not imply that the ideal is the unit ideal.
en.sourceTitle: The Stacks Project, Hilbert Nullstellensatz, Tag 00FV
en.locator: Theorem 10.34.1 and its proof; algebraically closed specialization.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: HTML theorem Tag 00FV, both clauses and proof; algebraically closed specialization explicitly stated by atlas
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 曲率积分 → 欧拉示性数
zh.mechanism: 局部曲率的积分通过 Gauss–Bonnet 转换为拓扑不变量。
zh.conditions: 采用所引讲义的范围：R^3 中光滑、紧致、无边界、可定向的正则曲面，取诱导度量。
zh.conclusion: ∫M K dA=2πχ(M)。
zh.limitations: 有边界需加边界曲率项；非紧情形不能直接套用此式。相同总曲率不能反推同一个度量或曲率分布。
zh.sourceTitle: Robert Hale, The Gauss–Bonnet Theorem, University of Chicago REU (2022)
zh.locator: Global Gauss–Bonnet statement; institutional expository source。

en.title: Integrated curvature → Euler characteristic
en.mechanism: Gauss–Bonnet converts the integral of local curvature into a topological invariant.
en.conditions: The scope of the cited notes: a smooth, compact, orientable regular surface in R^3 without boundary, equipped with the induced metric.
en.conclusion: ∫M K dA=2πχ(M).
en.limitations: A boundary requires an additional boundary-curvature term; the formula does not apply directly to the noncompact case. Equal total curvature does not determine the same metric or curvature distribution.
en.sourceTitle: Robert Hale, The Gauss–Bonnet Theorem, University of Chicago REU (2022)
en.locator: Global Gauss–Bonnet statement; institutional expository source.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 1, 12; author Robert Hale; Theorem 5.5; atlas uses compact boundaryless regular surfaces in R^3
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: Brownian 路径 → 抛物型 PDE
zh.mechanism: 沿 Brownian 路径对初值和势函数取期望，把概率演化转为带势热方程的解。
zh.conditions: 保守的充分范围：R^d 上有界、非负、光滑势 V 和有界光滑初值 f；固定有限 t。 Brownian 运动的生成元取 (1/2)Δ。
zh.conclusion: u(t,x)=E_x[exp(−∫0^t V(Bs)ds)f(Bt)] 解 ∂t u=(1/2)Δu−Vu，u(0,x)=f(x)。
zh.limitations: 对无界势、爆炸扩散或边界停止问题需要额外可积性和边界条件。
zh.sourceTitle: Steven Lalley, Stochastic Differential Equations, Diffusion Processes, and the Feynman–Kac Formula
zh.locator: Feynman–Kac theorem; stated here in conservative smooth bounded scope。

en.title: Brownian paths → Parabolic PDEs
en.mechanism: Take expectations involving the initial data and potential along Brownian paths, turning probabilistic evolution into a solution of the heat equation with a potential.
en.conditions: A conservative sufficient scope: a bounded, nonnegative, smooth potential V on R^d and bounded smooth initial data f, at fixed finite t. Brownian motion has generator (1/2)Δ.
en.conclusion: u(t,x)=E_x[exp(−∫0^t V(Bs)ds)f(Bt)] solves ∂t u=(1/2)Δu−Vu, with u(0,x)=f(x).
en.limitations: Unbounded potentials, explosive diffusions, or stopping at a boundary require additional integrability and boundary conditions.
en.sourceTitle: Steven Lalley, Stochastic Differential Equations, Diffusion Processes, and the Feynman–Kac Formula
en.locator: Feynman–Kac theorem; stated here in conservative smooth bounded scope.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 7, Theorem 4; nonnegative potential, bounded data, d-dimensional Brownian generator
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 稀疏几何 → 凸优化恢复
zh.mechanism: 以受限等距性控制稀疏方向，将欠定观测中的稀疏恢复问题交给带噪声约束的 ℓ1 最小化。
zh.conditions: 矩阵的受限等距常数满足 δ_(3S)+3δ_(4S)<2（所引论文定理 1）。 真实误差满足 ||e||2≤ε；使用约束 ℓ1 问题的全局最小解。
zh.conclusion: 足够稀疏向量的恢复误差由观测噪声控制；近似稀疏时额外包含尾部逼近误差。
zh.limitations: 不是任意低秩矩阵、任意可行解或未检查噪声半径都能恢复；本条不混用后续文献的更优 RIP 常数。
zh.sourceTitle: Candès, Romberg, Tao, Stable Signal Recovery from Incomplete and Inaccurate Measurements (2006)

en.title: Sparse geometry → Recovery by convex optimization
en.mechanism: Use restricted isometry to control sparse directions, reducing recovery from underdetermined measurements to ℓ1 minimization subject to a noise constraint.
en.conditions: The matrix's restricted isometry constants satisfy δ_(3S)+3δ_(4S)<2, as in Theorem 1 of the cited paper. The actual error obeys ||e||2≤ε, and a global minimizer of the constrained ℓ1 problem is used.
en.conclusion: The recovery error for sufficiently sparse vectors is controlled by the measurement noise. For approximately sparse vectors, an additional tail-approximation error appears.
en.limitations: Recovery is not guaranteed for arbitrary low-rank matrices, arbitrary feasible solutions, or an unchecked noise radius. This entry does not substitute sharper RIP constants from later literature.
en.sourceTitle: Candès, Romberg, Tao, Stable Signal Recovery from Incomplete and Inaccurate Measurements (2006)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 3–4; Theorems 1–2, delta_3S+3delta_4S<2 and approximate sparsity tail
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 概率集中 → 欧氏降维
zh.mechanism: 随机投影对一个向量的长度集中，再对有限点对作 union bound，得到同时保持距离的嵌入。
zh.conditions: n≥2 个欧氏点，0<ε<1，目标维数 k 为正整数。 目标维数 k≥4 log(n)/(ε²/2−ε³/3) 可采用所引证明；k≥原维数时可用等距嵌入。
zh.conclusion: 存在到 R^k 的映射，使所有点对平方距离落在原值的 (1±ε) 范围内。
zh.limitations: 不是保持整个连续空间中所有点对，也不能直接替代一般度量空间嵌入定理。
zh.sourceTitle: Dasgupta and Gupta, An elementary proof of a theorem of Johnson and Lindenstrauss (2003)

en.title: Concentration of measure → Euclidean dimension reduction
en.mechanism: A random projection concentrates the length of a single vector. A union bound over finitely many pairs then yields an embedding preserving all pairwise distances simultaneously.
en.conditions: n≥2 Euclidean points, 0<ε<1, and a positive integer target dimension k. The cited proof applies for k≥4 log(n)/(ε²/2−ε³/3). When k is at least the original dimension, an isometric embedding can be used.
en.conclusion: There is a map into R^k under which every squared pairwise distance lies within a factor of (1±ε) of its original value.
en.limitations: This does not preserve every pair of points in an entire continuous space, and it cannot directly replace embedding theorems for general metric spaces.
en.sourceTitle: Dasgupta and Gupta, An elementary proof of a theorem of Johnson and Lindenstrauss (2003)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 2; Theorem 2.1 and random-projection/union-bound proof outline
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 拓扑零点原理 → 多项式划分
zh.mechanism: 把多项式系数看作参数空间，借拓扑零点论证同时平衡细胞中的代数簇交会数。
zh.conditions: Γ 是 R^n 中有限个 k 维、复杂度有统一界的实代数簇。 D≥1；复杂度界固定后常数才能统一。
zh.conclusion: 存在非零 deg P≤D，使 R^n\Z(P) 每个连通分支与至多 C D^(k−n)|Γ| 个成员相交。
zh.limitations: 不控制落在 Z(P) 上的部分；一个簇可穿过多个细胞；这里不是高效构造算法的保证。
zh.sourceTitle: Larry Guth, Polynomial partitioning for a set of varieties (2015)

en.title: A topological zero principle → Polynomial partitioning
en.mechanism: Treat polynomial coefficients as a parameter space and use a topological zero argument to balance simultaneously the numbers of varieties meeting the cells.
en.conditions: Γ is a finite collection of k-dimensional real algebraic varieties in R^n with uniformly bounded complexity. D≥1; a uniform constant requires a fixed complexity bound.
en.conclusion: There is a nonzero polynomial P of degree at most D such that each connected component of R^n\Z(P) meets at most C D^(k−n)|Γ| members of Γ.
en.limitations: The statement does not control the parts lying in Z(P). One variety may cross multiple cells. This is not a guarantee of an efficient construction algorithm.
en.sourceTitle: Larry Guth, Polynomial partitioning for a set of varieties (2015)

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF pp. 2–4; Theorem 0.3, failed naive balancing, Theorem 1.2 and product-polynomial construction
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 半正定优化 → 零误差容量上界
zh.mechanism: 用正交表示或等价的半正定规划定义 Lovász θ；借图乘积性质控制独立集增长。
zh.conditions: 有限无向简单图；Shannon 容量使用强图乘积的独立数增长率。
zh.conclusion: α(G)≤Θ(G)≤θ(G)；五边形 C5 有 Θ(C5)=√5。
zh.limitations: 一般图不保证 Θ(G)=θ(G)；高精度数值 SDP 结果需额外误差控制才能成为严格上界证书。
zh.sourceTitle: László Lovász, On the Shannon Capacity of a Graph (1979)
zh.locator: Definition of theta and capacity upper bound。

en.title: Semidefinite optimization → An upper bound on zero-error capacity
en.mechanism: Define Lovász θ through orthogonal representations or an equivalent semidefinite program, and use graph-product properties to control the growth of independent sets.
en.conditions: Finite undirected simple graphs; Shannon capacity is defined by the growth rate of independence numbers under the strong graph product.
en.conclusion: α(G)≤Θ(G)≤θ(G); for the pentagon C5, Θ(C5)=√5.
en.limitations: Equality Θ(G)=θ(G) is not guaranteed for general graphs. High-precision numerical SDP output requires additional error control before it becomes a rigorous upper-bound certificate.
en.sourceTitle: László Lovász, On the Shannon Capacity of a Graph (1979)
en.locator: Definition of theta and capacity upper bound.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 2 rendered as image; strong product, theta via orthogonal representations, Theorems 1–2
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 有限域插值 → Reed–Solomon 码
zh.mechanism: 把消息作为低次多项式的系数，在多个不同的有限域元素上求值；根数界把多项式差异转成 Hamming 距离。
zh.conditions: 有限域 Fq；1≤k≤n≤q；n 个求值点互异。 求值多项式次数严格小于 k。
zh.conclusion: 得到 [n,k,n−k+1]q 码；任意 k 个无误符号可插值恢复消息。
zh.limitations: 擦除恢复与未知位置错误纠正是不同保证；重复求值点会破坏距离论证。
zh.sourceTitle: MIT 6.885 Algebra and Computation, Lecture 16 (2005), Reed–Solomon evaluation codes; original: Reed and Solomon (1960)
zh.locator: Section on Reed–Solomon codes; primary course notes, not a scan of the 1960 paper。

en.title: Interpolation over finite fields → Reed–Solomon codes
en.mechanism: Encode a message as the coefficients of a low-degree polynomial and evaluate it at distinct finite-field elements. A bound on the number of roots turns polynomial differences into Hamming distance.
en.conditions: A finite field Fq; 1≤k≤n≤q; n distinct evaluation points. The evaluated polynomials have degree strictly less than k.
en.conclusion: This gives an [n,k,n−k+1]q code. Any k error-free symbols recover the message by interpolation.
en.limitations: Recovery from erasures and correction of errors at unknown locations are different guarantees. Repeated evaluation points invalidate the distance argument.
en.sourceTitle: MIT 6.885 Algebra and Computation, Lecture 16 (2005), Reed–Solomon evaluation codes; original: Reed and Solomon (1960)
en.locator: Section on Reed–Solomon codes; primary course notes, not a scan of the 1960 paper.

sourceAudit.passage_read_scope: PDF p. 1, Section 3: polynomial messages and distinct-point evaluation; [n,k,n-k+1] is the explicit standard root-counting consequence
sourceAudit.mathematical_review: Selected statement, scope, mechanism and caveats reviewed; full proof not rederived.

zh.title: 多项式根数界 → 交互式证明
zh.mechanism: 逐轮将高维有限和压为一元多项式一致性检查，用新鲜随机挑战把虚假等式的通过概率限制在根数比例内。
zh.conditions: 有限域 F；每个变量次数至多 d；m 轮。 验证者逐轮检查次数并使用独立均匀挑战；最后能可信求值目标多项式。
zh.conclusion: 标准 sum-check 具有完备性，虚假和的接受概率至多 md/|F|（并且总是不超过 1）。
zh.limitations: 复用挑战、取消次数检查、或把最终求值交给未验证的回答都会失去该保证。
zh.sourceTitle: Justin Thaler, The Sum-Check Protocol; Proofs, Arguments, and Zero-Knowledge

en.title: Polynomial root bounds → Interactive proofs
en.mechanism: Reduce a high-dimensional finite sum, round by round, to consistency checks for univariate polynomials. Fresh random challenges bound the probability of accepting a false equality by the corresponding fraction of roots.
en.conditions: A finite field F, degree at most d in each variable, and m rounds. The verifier checks degrees at every round and uses independent uniform challenges; it can evaluate the target polynomial reliably at the end.
en.conclusion: The standard sum-check protocol is complete, and the probability of accepting a false sum is at most md/|F|, and always at most 1.
en.limitations: Reusing challenges, omitting degree checks, or relying on an unverified answer for the final evaluation loses this guarantee.
en.sourceTitle: Justin Thaler, The Sum-Check Protocol; Proofs, Arguments, and Zero-Knowledge
